title: Lemma 7.2.1: existence of a mass-minimizing integral filling
statement: Let m, ℓ ≥ 0, P = m+2+ℓ, and S ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(ℝ^P) integer multiplicity with spt S compact and ∂S = 0. Then there is an integer multiplicity T ∈ 𝒟_{m+2}(ℝ^P) with spt T compact, ∂T = S, and M(T) ≤ M(R) for every integer multiplicity R ∈ 𝒟_{m+2}(ℝ^P) with spt R compact and ∂R = S.
